articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually drops AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like breadcrumbs for nation-states. The agency that's supposed to protect our infrastructure couldn't protect their own secrets from a public repo—peak cybersecurity theater.

articles.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Linux Flaws, Defender 0-Days, Router Botnets, and Supply Chain Chaos
articles.summary: Japanese LMS gets pwned via SQL injection zero-day, serving up Godzilla web shells and Cobalt Strike like a malware buffet. Sometimes the monster movies write themselves.

articles.title: The Alert Firehose Finally Meets Its Match
articles.summary: Ghost CMS critical SQLi flaw (CVE-2026-26980) gets exploited to hijack 700+ sites for ClickFix attacks. When your blogging platform becomes a botnet, you know we've hit peak internet.

articles.title: Iranian Hackers Deploy MiniFast and MiniJunk V2 via Phishing and SEO Poisoning
articles.summary: Trump Mobile website leaking customer data to anyone with basic HTTP skills—turns out MAGA includes 'Make APIs Glaringly Accessible.' The grift extends to cybersecurity now.

articles.title: The sandworm malware strikes: How a hacker group stole 4,000 GitHub repositories and exposed the rot at the core of modern software security
articles.summary: Hacker selling 340M OnlyFans user records compiled from old breaches and public profiles. Nothing says 'privacy violation' like weaponizing porn site data for profit.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a win for encrypted messaging while governments worldwide sharpen their crypto-breaking tools. End-to-end encryption: the last firewall between your secrets and surveillance capitalism.

articles.title: Akamai Joins Growing Chorus of Vendors Betting Big on Secure Enterprise Browsers
articles.summary: EFF's new guide fights back against normalized digital surveillance abuses across the Americas. Because apparently we need instruction manuals to remember that mass spying is bad.

articles.title: Techie claims Trump Mobile website was leaking thousands of people's data
articles.summary: Megalodon campaign poisons 5,500+ GitHub repos in massive supply chain attack. The open source ecosystem gets chummed harder than a Shark Week feeding frenzy.

articles.title: Hacker Selling 340 Million OnlyFans User Records Built From Old Breaches
articles.summary: Hookwarden tool finds webhook HMAC bugs across multiple languages in under five minutes. Finally, someone built a tool to catch the authentication failures that keep pwning APIs.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: Congress demands answers as CISA scrambles to contain their contractor's GitHub data leak. When the cybersecurity agency needs cybersecurity help, democracy weeps softly into its keyboard.
